people.nameZh: 富蘭克林·德拉諾·羅斯福

heading.en: Origins, schooling and the state senate

body.zh-Hant: 羅斯福1882年1月30日生於紐約州海德公園，是詹姆斯·羅斯福與莎拉·德拉諾·羅斯福之子。他就讀格羅頓學校（1896至1900年），三年內取得哈佛歷史學士（1900至1903年），1907年通過律師資格考試。1905年他與遠房表親安娜·愛蓮娜·羅斯福結婚。1910年他踏入政壇，當選紐約州參議員，1912年連任。
body.en: Franklin D. Roosevelt was born at Hyde Park, New York on 30 January 1882, son of James and Sara Delano Roosevelt. He attended Groton (1896-1900), took a Harvard history BA in three years (1900-03) and passed the bar in 1907. In 1905 he married a distant cousin, Anna Eleanor Roosevelt. He entered politics in 1910, was elected to the New York State Senate and was re-elected in 1912.

heading.zh-Hant: 海軍助理部長與副總統候選人
heading.en: Assistant Secretary of the Navy and vice-presidential nominee

body.zh-Hant: 1913年3月17日，羅斯福在威爾遜政府宣誓就任海軍助理部長；來源說明這是威爾遜對他支持的回報。1914年他在民主黨初選中敗給傑拉德，未能取得聯邦參議員提名。1920年7月6日，他在舊金山的民主黨全國大會被提名為副總統候選人，與俄亥俄州的考克斯搭檔；8月6日他辭去海軍助理部長，11月2日在大選中落敗。
body.en: On 17 March 1913 Roosevelt was sworn in as Assistant Secretary of the Navy in the Wilson administration, a reward for his support. In 1914 he lost the Democratic primary for the US Senate to James W. Gerard. On 6 July 1920 the Democratic convention in San Francisco nominated him for Vice-President on the ticket headed by James M. Cox of Ohio; he resigned from the Navy post on 6 August and was defeated on 2 November.

heading.zh-Hant: 小兒麻痺、紐約州長與當選總統
heading.en: Polio, governorship and election as President

body.zh-Hant: 1921年8月，羅斯福在坎波貝洛島罹患小兒麻痺症，此後再也無法恢復雙腿的功能。1927年他成立喬治亞溫泉基金會。1928年10月2日紐約州民主黨提名他競選州長，11月6日當選；他任州長至1932年底，1930年連任。1932年7月1日民主黨在芝加哥大會第四輪投票提名他為總統候選人，11月8日他擊敗胡佛當選總統。
body.en: In August 1921 Roosevelt was stricken with poliomyelitis at Campobello and never regained the use of his legs. In 1927 he formed the Georgia Warm Springs Foundation. New York Democrats nominated him for governor on 2 October 1928 and he was elected on 6 November; he served 1929-1932 and was re-elected in 1930. The party nominated him for president on the fourth ballot on 1 July 1932 and he defeated Hoover on 8 November.

heading.zh-Hant: 總統任內：新政、戰爭與逝世
heading.en: Presidency: New Deal, war and death

body.zh-Hant: 1933年3月4日羅斯福就職，面對美國自內戰以來最嚴重的危機，隨即推動新政；1935年又有一波新政立法。他在1936年擊敗蘭登、1940年擊敗威爾基、1944年擊敗杜威，成為唯一任期超過兩任的美國總統。1941年8月他在紐芬蘭阿根夏與邱吉爾會談並公布《大西洋憲章》；12月7日珍珠港遭日本突襲。1945年1月20日他第四度就職，4月12日在喬治亞州溫泉鎮突發嚴重中風，兩個半小時後去世，葬於海德公園。
body.en: Roosevelt was inaugurated on 4 March 1933 facing the greatest crisis since the Civil War and launched the New Deal; another wave of legislation followed in 1935. He defeated Landon (1936), Willkie (1940) and Dewey (1944), the only president to serve more than two terms. In August 1941 he met Churchill at Argentia, Newfoundland, and announced the Atlantic Charter; Pearl Harbor was attacked on 7 December 1941. He was inaugurated a fourth time on 20 January 1945 and died of a massive stroke at Warm Springs, Georgia, on 12 April 1945; he was buried at Hyde Park.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、流亡瑞士與社會黨早年
heading.en: Origins, Switzerland and early socialist career

body.zh-Hant: 墨索里尼1883年7月29日生於福爾利省普雷達皮奧的多維亞。1901年7月取得小學教師文憑，1902年7月出走瑞士，1909年2月6日轉往特倫托任勞工會書記，同年9月27日被逐出特倫托地區。他回到福爾利，在社會黨地方組織中活動。1912年7月7日至10日在雷焦艾米利亞召開的社會黨第十三屆黨大會上，他所屬的革命派奪得黨的領導權。
body.en: Mussolini was born on 29 July 1883 at Dovia di Predappio. He took his teaching diploma in July 1901, left for Switzerland in July 1902, moved to Trento on 6 February 1909 as secretary of the labour chamber and was expelled from the Trentino on 27 September 1909. Back in Forli he worked in the local socialist organisation. At the 13th PSI congress at Reggio Emilia (7-10 July 1912) the revolutionary faction he belonged to won the leadership of the party.

Conseguito il diploma magistrale nel luglio 1901
fu nominato nel febbraio 1902 maestro supplente a Gualtieri Emilia

heading.zh-Hant: 《前進報》、中途轉向與法西斯戰鬥團
heading.en: Avanti!, the break with the PSI and the Fasci

body.zh-Hant: 1912年底他出任社會黨機關報《前進報》主編並遷往米蘭。1914年10月20日，他的立場轉變在波隆那會議上遭黨領導層否決，辭去主編職務；11月15日他創辦《義大利人民報》，24日米蘭社會黨支部決議將他逐出社會黨。1915年8月31日他入伍；戰後他於1919年3月23日創立法西斯戰鬥團。
body.en: At the end of 1912 he became editor of the party daily Avanti! and moved to Milan. On 20 October 1914 his change of position was rejected by the party leadership at a meeting in Bologna and he resigned the editorship; on 15 November he launched Il Popolo d'Italia, and on 24 November the Milan socialist section expelled him from the PSI. He became a soldier on 31 August 1915 and on 23 March 1919 founded the Fasci italiani di combattimento.

heading.zh-Hant: 國會議員、國家法西斯黨與進軍羅馬
heading.en: Deputy, the PNF and the March on Rome

body.zh-Hant: 1919年11月選舉，墨索里尼得票不到五千票。1921年5月，法西斯戰鬥團參加國會選舉，他在博洛尼亞與米蘭當選。同年11月7日至10日在羅馬召開的大會決議把運動改組為國家法西斯黨（PNF），與會者承認他為「領袖」。1922年10月，動員日定在10月28日；法克塔內閣任期至10月31日為止。
body.en: In the November 1919 election Mussolini won fewer than 5,000 votes. In May 1921 the Fasci stood in the general election and he was elected at Bologna and Milan. The congress held in Rome on 7-10 November 1921 turned the movement into the National Fascist Party (PNF), whose members recognised him as 'duce'. In October 1922 mobilisation was fixed for 28 October; Facta's government lasted until 31 October 1922.

heading.zh-Hant: 政府首腦與法西斯政權
heading.en: Head of government and the Fascist regime

body.zh-Hant: 1922年10月29日他受命組閣，國王任命他為首相；同年12月成立法西斯大委員會。1924年4月6日的選舉後，6月10日社會黨議員馬泰奧蒂遭殺害；1925年1月3日他在眾議院發表演說，走向公開獨裁。1926年底各政黨被取締。1935年10月3日他發動衣索比亞戰爭，1936年5月9日宣告帝國重現；1940年6月10日義大利參戰。1943年7月25日起，法西斯政權崩潰。
body.en: On 29 October 1922 he was charged with forming a government and the king appointed him prime minister; the Fascist Grand Council was set up in December 1922. After the election of 6 April 1924 the socialist deputy Matteotti was killed on 10 June; on 3 January 1925 Mussolini spoke in the Chamber and moved to open dictatorship. Parties were suppressed at the end of 1926. He launched the Ethiopian war on 3 October 1935, announced the Empire on 9 May 1936 and took Italy into war on 10 June 1940. The regime collapsed after 25 July 1943.

body.zh-Hant: 1943年7月24日至25日，墨索里尼被法西斯大委員會推翻，國王將他免職並逮捕；9月12日德軍將他救出。9月23日他在德國協助下組成法西斯反政府，建立義大利社會共和國（撒羅共和國），並以其首腦自居。1945年4月27日他被游擊隊俘虜，次日在朱利諾迪梅扎格拉遭槍決。
body.en: On 24-25 July 1943 the Fascist Grand Council deposed Mussolini, and the king dismissed and arrested him; on 12 September German troops freed him. On 23 September, with German help, he formed a Fascist counter-government and proclaimed the Italian Social Republic (Salo), placing himself at its head. On 27 April 1945 he was captured by partisans and the next day shot at Giulino di Mezzegra.

heading.zh-Hant: 誕生、立太子與歐洲訪問
heading.en: Birth, investiture as crown prince and the European tour

body.zh-Hant: 昭和天皇（裕仁）1901年4月29日生於東京青山的東宮御所，是大正天皇的長子。1912年7月30日明治天皇駕崩，他成為皇太子，1916年11月3日舉行立太子禮，1919年5月7日舉行成年式。1921年3月起他訪問歐洲諸國約六個月，9月3日返國。
body.en: Hirohito was born on 29 April 1901 at the Togu Palace in Aoyama, Tokyo, first son of the Taisho Emperor. On 30 July 1912, with the death of the Meiji Emperor, he became crown prince; the investiture took place on 3 November 1916 and his coming-of-age ceremony on 7 May 1919. From March 1921 he toured Europe for six months and returned on 3 September.

body.zh-Hant: 1921年11月25日，因大正天皇患病，皇太子裕仁就任攝政。依大日本帝國憲法第17條，攝政以天皇的名義行使大權。1924年1月26日他與久邇宮邦彥王的長女良子女王結婚。攝政期間至1926年12月25日大正天皇駕崩為止。
body.en: On 25 November 1921, because the Taisho Emperor was ill, Crown Prince Hirohito became regent; under Article 17 of the Meiji Constitution a regent exercised the prerogatives in the Emperor's name. On 26 January 1924 he married Princess Nagako, eldest daughter of Prince Kuninomiya Kuniyoshi. The regency lasted until the Taisho Emperor's death on 25 December 1926.

body.zh-Hant: 1926年12月25日大正天皇駕崩，裕仁立即踐祚，成為第124代天皇，當日改元昭和。1928年11月10日在京都舉行即位禮，11月14日、15日舉行大嘗祭。
body.en: On the death of the Taisho Emperor on 25 December 1926 Hirohito acceded at once as the 124th emperor and the era was renamed Showa the same day. The enthronement ceremony was held in Kyoto on 10 November 1928 and the Daijosai on 14-15 November.

heading.zh-Hant: 統帥權、大本營與戰爭終結
heading.en: Supreme command, Imperial Headquarters and the end of the war

body.zh-Hant: 大日本帝國憲法第11條規定天皇統帥陸海軍。1937年11月20日，作為戰時最高統帥機關的大本營設於宮中，存續至1945年9月13日。1945年東京遭空襲，宮殿於5月26日燒毀。8月14日終戰詔書發布，天皇當日錄音，15日正午透過廣播向國民宣布。
body.en: Article 11 of the Meiji Constitution gave the Emperor command of the army and navy. On 20 November 1937 Imperial Headquarters, the supreme wartime command organ, was set up in the palace and lasted until 13 September 1945. In 1945 Tokyo was bombed and the palace burned on 26 May. The rescript ending the war was issued on 14 August; the Emperor recorded it that day and it was broadcast at noon on 15 August.
